title: GSLV And Various Engine
definition: Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) is a three-stage heavy-lift launch vehicle developed by ISRO designed to place heavier payloads like communication satellites into Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO), characterized by its critical indigenous cryogenic upper stage.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science & Technology syllabus under Space Technology, achievements of Indians in science & tech, and technology indigenization. Frequently tested in Prelims regarding rocket stages, cryogenic fuels, and engine types (S139, Vikas, CUD/CE-7.5, CE-20), and in Mains for strategic self-reliance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of GSLV And Various Engine.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
